newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Birch says NZ economic conditions good for growth.
newsitem.headline: Birch says NZ economic conditions good for growth.

text.p: New Zealand Finance Minister Bill Birch said on Tuesday that although New Zealand was at the bottom of its current economic cycle and business confidence was low, conditions were still good for growth and investment.
"I think the (business) confidence is more a view about the conditions that we had last year," Birch told Radio New Zealand.

"Conditions are very competitive, we have a very competitive economy and the increase in the exchange rate last year did put considerable competitive pressure on the exporters, there's no doubt about that. And some of the confidence factor is a reflection of that.

"But those conditions have changed quite significantly in the first part of this year, and looking ahead, one now has much lower interest rates...the exchange rate is much more stable, we've got forecasts for continuing low inflation and we've got good trading conditions amongst our trading partners," Birch said.
A survey released by the National Bank on Tuesday showed that New Zealand's economic growth had fallen to a five-year low of 2.6 percent in the March 1997 quarter.
But Birch said business people needed to get their views out of the rear vision mirror.
"Looking ahead, conditions will continue to be good for investment and for growth," he said.
